FIN_ROLES = {"Адміністратор", "Фінансист", "Бухгалтер"}
_role_cache = {}
DIAG = "/root/findata-diag.log"
DIAG_ON = False   # діагностика вимкнена; файл лишається на місці
def _diag(msg):
    if not DIAG_ON: return
    try:
        with open(DIAG, "a") as f:
            f.write("%s %s\n" % (time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), msg))
        os.chmod(DIAG, 0o600)
    except Exception:
        pass

def get_role(jwt):
    c = _role_cache.get(jwt)
    if c and time.time() - c[1] < 300:
        _diag("cache -> %r" % (c[0],))
        return c[0]
    _diag("jwt довжина=%d" % len(jwt or ""))
    try:
        r = urllib.request.Request(NC + "/api/v1/auth/user/me", headers={"xc-auth": jwt})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=10) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode()
            me = json.loads(raw)
        _diag("me: status=%s ключі=%s" % (resp.status, sorted(me.keys())[:12]))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        _diag("me HTTP %s" % e.code)
        return "__EXPIRED__" if e.code in (401, 403) else None
    except Exception as e:
        _diag("me ПОМИЛКА: %s %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:120]))
        return None
    email = (me.get("email") or "").lower()
    _diag("email знайдено=%s домен=%s" % (bool(email), email.split("@")[-1] if "@" in email else "-"))
    if not email: return None
    try:
        r2 = urllib.request.Request(NC + "/api/v2/tables/%s/records?limit=100" % USERS_T, headers={"xc-token": ADMIN_TOK})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r2, timeout=10) as resp:
            users = json.loads(resp.read().decode()).get("list", [])
    except Exception as e:
        _diag("таблиця користувачів ПОМИЛКА: %s %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:120]))
        return None
    _diag("користувачів=%d, збіг email=%s" % (len(users), any(str(u.get("Email") or "").lower() == email for u in users)))
    row = next((u for u in users if str(u.get("Email") or "").lower() == email and u.get("Активний") is not False), None)
    role = row.get("Роль") if row else None
    _diag("роль=%r у FIN_ROLES=%s" % (role, role in FIN_ROLES))
    if role is not None:
        _role_cache[jwt] = (role, time.time())
    return role

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _send(self, code, obj):
        body = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def do_GET(self):
        q = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        if not q.path.startswith("/finrep-data"): return self._send(404, {"error": "not found"})
        name = urllib.parse.parse_qs(q.query).get("name", [""])[0]
        if name not in FILES: return self._send(400, {"error": "bad name"})
        jwt = self.headers.get("xc-auth", "")
        role = get_role(jwt) if jwt else None
